_note: Bổ sung A2+ theo Oxford 3000 (28/10/2026, Claude soạn, chưa người thật kiểm): từ Oxford A2 app còn thiếu, phần khó hơn (người sáng lập: "tự tính làm tiếp"). Không thêm dạng suy ra được từ từ gốc đã có (-ly, -ing, -er). Áp bằng node tools/fix-pre.mjs.

units.vi: Bổ sung Oxford 1: con người và công việc

words.en: always busy doing things, especially physical ones
words.ex: My grandmother is very active. She walks every day.
words.exVi: Bà tôi rất năng động. Ngày nào bà cũng đi bộ.

cloze.s: Children should stay ___ and play outside.

exam.s: My uncle is very active for his age.

words.en: the design of buildings, or the style of buildings
words.ex: I love the old French architecture in Hanoi.
words.exVi: Tôi thích kiến trúc Pháp cổ ở Hà Nội.

cloze.s: She wants to study ___ and design houses.

exam.s: The city is famous for its old architecture.

words.en: a machine for cooking food (not a person who cooks)
words.ex: We have a new gas cooker in the kitchen.
words.exVi: Nhà tôi có bếp ga mới trong bếp.

cloze.s: Put the pan on the ___ and heat the oil.

exam.s: My mother bought a new rice cooker.

words.en: good at thinking of new ideas or making new things
words.ex: She is very creative and makes her own clothes.
words.exVi: Cô ấy rất sáng tạo, tự may quần áo cho mình.

cloze.s: Artists and designers need to be ___.

exam.s: My brother has many creative ideas.

words.en: going straight from one place to another without stopping
words.ex: Is there a direct flight to London?
words.exVi: Có chuyến bay thẳng tới London không?

cloze.s: We took a ___ train with no stops.

exam.s: There is no direct bus to the airport.

words.en: a conversation about something important
words.ex: We had a long discussion about the holiday.
words.exVi: Chúng tôi thảo luận rất lâu về kỳ nghỉ.

cloze.s: The class had a ___ about the environment.

exam.s: We had an interesting discussion in class.

words.en: to pay someone to work for you
words.ex: The company employs two hundred people.
words.exVi: Công ty thuê hai trăm người.

cloze.s: The hotel ___ fifty workers.

exam.s: The factory employs many young people.

words.en: a person who is paid to work for someone
words.ex: Every employee gets a day off on their birthday.
words.exVi: Mỗi nhân viên được nghỉ một ngày vào sinh nhật.

cloze.s: The shop has ten ___.

exam.s: The company has five hundred employees.

words.en: the reasons or details that make something clear
words.ex: The teacher's explanation was very clear.
words.exVi: Lời giải thích của cô giáo rất rõ ràng.

cloze.s: There is no ___ for his bad behaviour.

exam.s: Thank you for your explanation.

units.vi: Bổ sung Oxford 2: học tập, ý tưởng

words.en: next; coming after
words.ex: We arrived on Monday and left the following day.
words.exVi: Chúng tôi đến hôm thứ Hai và rời đi vào hôm sau.

cloze.s: Answer the ___ questions.

exam.s: Read the following text carefully.

words.en: a long walk in the country or mountains
words.ex: We went on a five-hour hike in Sapa.
words.exVi: Chúng tôi đi bộ đường dài năm tiếng ở Sa Pa.

cloze.s: Let's go for a ___ in the mountains this weekend.

exam.s: We went on a long hike yesterday.

words.vi: lời giới thiệu, phần mở đầu
words.en: the first part of something, or the act of introducing people
words.ex: Read the introduction before you start the book.
words.exVi: Hãy đọc phần mở đầu trước khi đọc sách.

cloze.s: The ___ to the book is only two pages.

exam.s: Write a short introduction about yourself.

words.en: information and understanding that you have
words.ex: He has a good knowledge of history.
words.exVi: Anh ấy hiểu biết nhiều về lịch sử.

cloze.s: Reading books will improve your ___.

exam.s: My teacher has great knowledge of English.

words.en: the sound of people laughing
words.ex: We heard laughter from the next room.
words.exVi: Chúng tôi nghe tiếng cười từ phòng bên.

cloze.s: The room was full of ___ and music.

exam.s: There was a lot of laughter at the party.

words.en: connected with medicine and doctors
words.ex: She is a medical student at the university.
words.exVi: Cô ấy là sinh viên y.

cloze.s: You need ___ help. Call a doctor.

exam.s: He needs medical help after the accident.

words.en: a change of position
words.ex: I saw a movement in the trees.
words.exVi: Tôi thấy có gì động đậy trong cây.

cloze.s: Don't make any ___. The bird will fly away.

exam.s: I saw a quick movement in the grass.

words.en: a person who plays or writes music
words.ex: My uncle is a musician. He plays the guitar.
words.exVi: Chú tôi là nhạc công. Chú chơi ghi-ta.

cloze.s: The ___ played the piano beautifully.

exam.s: She wants to be a musician one day.

words.vi: cảnh sát, sĩ quan, cán bộ
words.en: a police officer, or a person with a position of authority
words.ex: A police officer helped the old man cross the road.
words.exVi: Một cảnh sát giúp ông cụ qua đường.

cloze.s: Ask the police ___ for help.

exam.s: The officer asked to see my passport.

units.vi: Bổ sung Oxford 3: đi lại và xã hội

words.en: something that might happen or be true
words.ex: There is a possibility of rain this afternoon.
words.exVi: Chiều nay có khả năng mưa.

cloze.s: Is there any ___ that the shop is open today?

exam.s: There is a possibility of snow tonight.

words.en: to make or grow something
words.ex: Vietnam produces a lot of coffee.
words.exVi: Việt Nam sản xuất rất nhiều cà phê.

cloze.s: This factory ___ cars.

exam.s: The farm produces milk and cheese.

words.en: a person who writes or talks about the news
words.ex: A reporter asked the singer some questions.
words.exVi: Một phóng viên hỏi ca sĩ vài câu.

cloze.s: The TV ___ is standing outside the hospital.

exam.s: The reporter wrote a story about our school.

words.en: achieving what you wanted to achieve
words.ex: Her new shop is very successful.
words.exVi: Cửa hàng mới của cô ấy rất thành công.

cloze.s: He is a ___ businessman with three companies.

exam.s: My aunt has a successful café.

words.en: making you feel surprised
words.ex: The end of the film was very surprising.
words.exVi: Kết phim rất bất ngờ.

cloze.s: It's ___ that nobody came to the party.

exam.s: The result of the game was surprising.

words.en: an idea or opinion
words.ex: What are your thoughts about the plan?
words.exVi: Bạn nghĩ gì về kế hoạch này?

cloze.s: I had a ___: why don't we go to the beach?

exam.s: Thank you for your kind thoughts.

words.en: the business of providing services for people on holiday
words.ex: Tourism is important for Hoi An.
words.exVi: Du lịch rất quan trọng với Hội An.

cloze.s: Many people in this town work in ___.

exam.s: Tourism brings a lot of money to the island.

words.vi: người đi du lịch, du khách
words.en: a person who is travelling or who often travels
words.ex: The hotel is popular with young travellers.
words.exVi: Khách sạn được nhiều du khách trẻ ưa thích.

cloze.s: Every ___ needs a passport.

exam.s: The café is full of travellers from Europe.
